notes.title: 🚀 MalovMetaArt: The Full VR Experience of World Art Has Arrived!
notes.content:
[h2]🚀 MalovMetaArt: The Full VR Experience of World Art Has Arrived![/h2]
Embark on an immersive journey into the heart of art with the official release of MalovMetaArt - your passport to the Metaverse of World Art. We're thrilled to introduce a VR Digital Museum that goes beyond boundaries, featuring 100% accurate 3D copies of sculptures, paintings, and various artworks, allowing you to touch and explore them from every angle.

[h2]🎨 Key Features:[/h2]
Diverse Art Collection: discover a treasure trove of paintings, sculptures, porcelain, and glass art.
Multifaceted Settings: experience art in different settings, from the vastness of space to the intimacy of a traditional museum room.
21 Galleries to Explore: dive into a curated selection of galleries, each offering a unique perspective on the world's artistic heritage.
Bilingual Experience: Choose English or Chinese to explore the art world seamlessly.
[h2]
🌐 Why MalovMetaArt?[/h2]
We've poured our heart and soul into creating a metaverse where art comes to life. Our team has meticulously crafted 3D replicas of renowned artworks, ensuring an authentic and captivating experience for art enthusiasts like you. Whether you're a connoisseur or a casual observer, MalovMetaArt invites you to be a part of a global celebration of creativity and culture.

[h2]💺 Comfortable Seated Mode:[/h2]
Immerse yourself comfortably with our seated mode, designed to make the VR journey as comfortable as possible, especially for people with disabilities. Enjoy the artistry for extended periods with a focus on accessibility.

[h2]🙌 Thank You for Your Support:[/h2]
We extend our deepest gratitude to our community for their unwavering support. Your enthusiasm has fueled our journey, and we can't wait for you to embark on this artistic adventure with us.

🌈 MalovMetaArt is now available on Steam - Step into the Metaverse of World Art today!
Join us in redefining the boundaries of art exploration in virtual reality. MalovMetaArt awaits your presence.

[h1]Happy Exploring![/h1]

notes.title: Exciting News: Introducing the Chinese Language Update to Our App!
notes.content:
Hey there, Steam Community!

We are beyond excited to unveil a brand-new enhancement to our application that is bound to take your experience to a whole new level. We are thrilled to announce that our app is now available in Chinese, bringing a whole new dimension to your interaction with our Virtual Museum.

Join us on this exciting journey as we open the doors to a wider audience and celebrate the boundless reach of artistry and language. The Chinese version of our app is more than an update; it's an invitation to explore, connect, and revel in the world of creativity.

Thank you for being an integral part of our Steam family. Your support and enthusiasm continue to drive us to create experiences that transcend borders and language barriers.

notes.title: MalovMetaArt Metavers is out! NOW!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that MalovMetaArt Metaverse is officially released.

Put on your preferred [b]VR headset[/b] and deep dive into the boundless Metaverse of World Art.

[h2]Have a nice journey! [/h2]

[previewyoutube=7kRCZiLYstM;full][/previewyoutube]

MalovMetaArt is a Metaverse of World Art, a digital museum that allows you to view the digital twins of world masterpieces that are identical to their physical originals.

The key distinction among MalovMetaArt and similar projects is the 100% accurate replication of artworks. Using photogrammetry and laser scanning techniques, we have created a way to create precise digital twins of the masterpieces of world art you see in the app. You can even touch, zoom and examine the artworks from all sides. In virtual space, you can hold an item (which is not allowed in a real museum) or get up close to unique paintings, so close that they can see the texture of each touch of the genius’s brush.
